name: Hazael
overview: The Scriptures reveal Hazael as a figure anointed by God through the prophet Elisha to become king over Syria, despite his initial disbelief (2 Kings 8:13). His rise to power involved deceit and violence, as Elisha foretold the great evil Hazael would inflict upon Israel, including burning their strongholds and slaughtering their people (2 Kings 8:12). This sober prophecy was accompanied by Elisha's deep sorrow, highlighting the grave consequences of Hazael's future reign (2 Kings 8:11). Hazael's story underscores God's sovereign control over history, even when it involves the rise of rulers who carry out judgment against His people.
